fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase ranked #1 in the 2026 Financial Quantum Index, leading across all three dimensions of workforce, R&D, and technology adoption.
fields.summary_ko.1: HSBC and Wells Fargo tied for #2, with Mastercard at #3, rising 15 steps versus 11 years ago and achieving the highest ranking among payment networks.
fields.summary_ko.2: The 2026 survey expanded from 28 to 64 entities covered, extending evaluation scope across the entire financial ecosystem including insurers, central banks, and asset managers.
